title: Due and Urgent Build Plan
eyebrow: Build plan for approval · option 1A, from your testing · issues #210, #211 and #212
approval: Build plan approved: due and urgency on cards

short.lead: This builds option 1A: every Board card with a priority or a due date gets one quiet line under its label. It goes on the same branch as the calm build and into pull request #209, so your test link shows it once it is pushed. It replaces the 'past its date' line I added near the end of the build, because a late date now shows in the new line.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it does.
items: Add the line to Board cards (#211)

The line shows a flag and the priority word in that priority's colour, then the same due-date chip the Projects screen already uses. It leaves out anything the card's coloured label already shows, and a done task shows no date. Seven new automatic tests cover each case.

items.alt: Board cards with a flag, priority word and due chip
items.caption: What step 1 builds.

items: Check it and hand it back (#212)

A browser check confirms the line at desktop and phone widths. I run all 13 browser checks and the automatic tests again, update the systems doc and the QA page, and move the issues back to 'needs review'.
Reply "Build plan approved: due and urgency on cards", or say what to change.

changes: One new line on cards with a priority or a due date.
Changed: `app/js/board-view.js`, `app/css/app.css` and their tests. Projects, Settings and the coloured label stay as they are.
